matrix: Flow: angry customer sentiment triggers hard escalation
description: When customer sentiment is classified as angry, routing triggers hard escalation immediately to ensure human handoff.

turns.say: This service is completely unacceptable, your product broke immediately!

HandoffOut.reply: I've passed this to a team member who will get back to you shortly.
HandoffOut.staff_note: The customer is upset because the product broke straight away. Nothing was answered yet.
